targetCompanyImage.name: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs
targetCompanyImage.subsector: Fuel cell and hydrogen equipment financing
targetCompanyImage.description: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs are financing vehicles used to support distributed fuel cell and hydrogen-powered equipment deployments. Their end users include commercial customers adopting hydrogen-powered mobility or power solutions that prefer project-style financing rather than outright equipment purchases. The model is asset-heavy and lease or service contract based, with Generate providing capital against deployed equipment assets. Public materials state that Generate provided Plug with a US$100 million debt facility in 2019 and describe Generate as a capital partner that allowed Plug to pursue deployments without issuing the same amount of corporate equity. The reviewed materials did not disclose individual SPV ownership structures, project-level revenue, or current outstanding asset balances. The 2020 Generate facility amendment increased and repriced an existing relationship, so it was not used to reset Generate's original owner-entry year.

milestones.event: Plug Power announced a US$100 million debt facility from Generate Capital to fund new fuel-cell project deployments.
Plug Power and Generate Capital restructured and increased the existing term loan facility.
